review_views.label: Full composition
review_views.evidence: The 1536x1024 RGB review candidate and overview contact were inspected against the exact composition guide. Candidate SHA-256: 6a1bc15d6bbab2536c542c206949c359ca6eac554ff8082faa9489abf128f5eb. Review mode: strict root Vision decision with Codex evidence recording, non-independent; root score: 84/100.
review_views.notes: J1 preserves the complete flat board: left sea, low coast, braided delta islands, north forest, connected river, circular capital, south-west port, road network, upper-right highland, and lower-right fields. This is the strongest full composition in the series so far. It remains unregistered and unpublished: docs and renderer were not modified, and no formal Golden promotion occurred.

review_views.notes: B1 palette measurements fail at RGB intersection 0.544535, HSV intersection 0.426768, Bhattacharyya 0.795501, and maximum mean channel delta 10.746760 against thresholds 0.72, 0.62, 0.90, and 12.0. At 50%, entropy retention is 0.959799, RMS 0.816674, and macrocell coverage 1.0, so RMS misses 0.82; at 25%, entropy is 0.928280, RMS 0.717348, and macrocell coverage 0.924479 and the scale passes. Exact and near-repetition proxies do not replace Vision and did not detect the region-specific semantic wallpaper behind the rejection.

review_views.label: Native review
review_views.notes: The board is coherent, borderless, and strictly flat. The sea is calmer and materially more successful than prior I-series attempts, while forest, highland, fields, and capital begin to show overly uniform mark systems.

review_views.label: 200% review
review_views.notes: Forest resolves into dense repeated loop/glyph/noise wallpaper; upper-right highland resolves into long parallel flowing hatch bands; lower-right fields resolve into rigid repeated rows and CAD-like parcels. Capital blocks also remain mechanically repeated.

review_views.label: 400% review
review_views.notes: The same semantic repetition becomes unequivocal at deep zoom. Forest marks read as a reusable loop/glyph vocabulary and isotropic noise; highland marks form dominant long parallel flow bands; field rows and parcel geometry repeat mechanically. These are immediate Golden-rejection failures.

review_views.label: Nine-region review
review_views.notes: All required regions are present with clean edge continuation and no pasted patch. The material defects are region-specific semantic repetition rather than missing geography or seam failure.

review_views.label: Sea, delta, and river
review_views.evidence: Native, 200%, 400%, and western nine-region panels were inspected.
review_views.notes: J1 has the best sea treatment so far: a calm dark wash with sparse short disconnected non-cellular marks, no I2-style cell lattice, and clean coast/delta/river continuity. The rejected-not-Golden candidate may retain only this water treatment as a material-only reference after an explicit future preflight; it is not authority for the full board, composition or geometry, forest, highland, fields, or capital.

review_views.label: Forest
review_views.evidence: North and north-centre panels at native, 200%, and 400%.
review_views.notes: The forest footprint and river/road clearances are correct, but dense closed curls, glyph-like micro-shapes, and isotropic-noise texture repeat across the region instead of reading as irregular stipple and broken micro-hachure.

review_views.label: Highland
review_views.notes: Projection remains flat and has no pictorial side faces, but the surface is dominated by long parallel flowing hatch bands rather than broad tonal zones with sparse direction-neutral broken hachure.

review_views.label: Fields and capital
review_views.evidence: Centre and lower-right panels at native, 200%, and 400%.
review_views.notes: Fields use rigid repeated row fills and CAD-like parcel construction. The capital is complete and flat with clear connections, but its rings, blocks, and repeated footprint vocabulary remain mechanically regular.

review_views.label: Port and networks
review_views.notes: The port, roads, river, delta branches, and capital connections are continuous and clean. No material network break was found.

summary: J1 is a strong compositional improvement: it preserves the complete strictly flat board, delivers the best sea treatment so far, and keeps roads, river, delta, capital, and port connections clean. It is nevertheless rejected as a Golden board. At deep zoom, forest becomes dense loop/glyph/isotropic-noise wallpaper, highland becomes long parallel flowing hatch bands, fields become rigid repeated row/CAD parcels, and the capital remains mechanically repeated. Automated B1 palette and 50% RMS failures also stand.
required_changes: Retain J1's complete strict-plan composition, continuous networks, and water material grammar.
Replace forest loops and isotropic glyph/noise texture with genuinely irregular areal stipple and broken micro-hachure without closed crowns or reusable motifs.
Replace upper-right long directional hatch bands with broad planar tonal zones plus sparse short direction-neutral broken hachure.
Replace field row wallpaper and rigid CAD parcels with irregular parcels and locally varied restrained crop marks.
Break the capital's mechanically repeated footprint vocabulary while preserving its circular plan and connections.
Meet the strict B1 palette gate and raise 50% RMS contrast retention to at least 0.82 without sacrificing quiet water or network clarity.
